empty.title: Stats are waiting for your first workout
empty.description: Let's build a plan. The numbers fill in as you run.

weekly.title: Weekly kilometres
weekly.noDone: No completed workouts yet. The bars fill in as you log sessions.
weekly.description: How much of the plan you've run, week by week.

load.title: Training load
load.note: A rough heuristic from RPE and duration, not a diagnosis.

explanations.insufficient: At least 8 sessions in 4 weeks and 3 in the last 7 days are needed. Keep logging.
explanations.low: Acute load is below your usual. Your body is resting.
explanations.sweet: Acute load tracks chronic load. Your rhythm is steady.
explanations.caution: Acute load is rising faster than chronic. Take care next week.
explanations.high: The load jump is large. Ease the intensity and give your body room to adapt.

recent.title: Recently logged
recent.emptyDescription: When you're ready, log a workout and the numbers fill in on their own.

coach.title: Last week
coach.underControl: You've got everything under control. Just keep going.
coach.weekAdjusted: The week starting {{day}}.{{month}}. has been adjusted.

predictor.title: Race prediction
predictor.empty: Add a recent race or a goal. I'll show your prediction.
predictor.outOfRange: The result is below the VDOT model range. Prediction is not reliable.
predictor.goalNote: Based on your goal pace. It reflects the goal, not your current fitness.
predictor.method: Estimate using the Daniels VDOT model. Error grows with the distance difference (±2-4%).

pb.title: Personal bests
pb.emptyDescription: Log a 5, 10 or 21 km run. The first record is always the sweetest.
pb.footer: Automatic from your logged workouts (±0.4% tolerance).

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Week by week: who has run the most.
leaderboard.noKm: No kilometres this week yet. Be the first to run.
leaderboard.notPublic: Turn on your public profile in settings to see your rank.
leaderboard.emptyDescription: Turn on your public profile and be first on the list.
leaderboard.adherenceEmptyTitle: Not enough plan data for this week.
leaderboard.adherenceEmptyDescription: This board tracks how closely you stick to your plan. It needs at least two planned runs this week.
leaderboard.adherenceSelfEmpty: Your plan does not have at least two runs for this week yet.
